page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block, every line in the centre: the author's name at top, then the large title word, volume line, "SIVE", the work title, its subtitle, a small italic line and the final word. Show-through from the reverse side appears as mirrored text and is left out. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The line "PARS SECUNDA" and the mirrored letters of the large title word are show-through from the reverse side and were not transcribed. The top line "IACOBI ALTING" is very faint and may be partly lost; "in loca quaedam selecta ex" is small and faint, so "selecta" is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The large word "OPERUM" is partly obscured by show-through and should be checked. No engraving or ornament is visible.
